method: Read-only AWS APIs, aggregate SQL with transaction READ ONLY, Neon account Billing UI, official provider pricing. No raw transcripts, questions, keys, resource identifiers or customer identities are retained.

neon.verification: Billing UI: Current plan Free $0/month; 100 CU-hours, 1GB storage per project.

mailgun.verification: User confirmed Free; official limit 100 messages/day, one custom sending domain. Account UI required login, so actual account contract was not independently verified.

cloudflare.verification: Wrangler configuration and production architecture inspected. Billing API authentication unavailable; Workers Paid $5/month is a planning provision, not a confirmed invoice.

job_timing_sample.limitation: Elapsed from first job claim to completion excludes Lambda initialization. No timing sample could be joined to a surviving video duration; these are NOT seconds-per-video-minute estimates. Mixed CloudWatch REPORT durations were excluded because most retained jobs are legacy evaluations.

planning_basis.fixed_allocation: 50 paid contracts, independent of Basic/Pro mix; same fixed allocation per contract.
planning_basis.neon: Reserve Launch compute 0.25 CU * 730h * $0.106 = $19.345/month even though current subscription is Free. Launch bills its entire compute/storage usage, without subtracting the Free plan allowance. No upgrade performed.
planning_basis.database: Existing 0.1GB + 16KiB per monthly video-minute and per monthly answer, accumulated for 12 months at $0.35/GB-month. Observed table/index storage: ~10.9KB/answer; uploaded scenes ~0.87/minute and ~10.6KB/scene. No automatic chat-history deletion exists; month 24 is modeled separately.
planning_basis.lambda: 5120MiB ARM64, 5120MiB ephemeral (first 512MiB free), Tokyo list prices verified from AWS offer publication 2026-09-19. Reserve 60 billed seconds total for transcription+indexing per 10-minute video; duration is unmeasured. Includes network waits/cold starts. Jobs assumed two per upload. Slower-case sensitivity triples duration.
planning_basis.embeddings: 125120 tokens / 485.933 video minutes = ~257.5 tokens/minute observed. Budget 600 tokens/minute * two passes (scene splitting + indexing).
planning_basis.ingestion_retries: Additional 3% of Whisper, Lambda, ingestion embeddings and Lambda outbound transfer, assumed rather than measured. Retries can incur cost without consuming more user quota.
planning_basis.monitoring_logs: $4/month account reserve: repository and production have seven alarms (six for the main worker prefix and one for its DLQ), capacity for up to seven opt-in metrics, plus logs retained 30 days. Planning split $0.70 alarms + $2.10 metrics + $0.80 logs + $0.40 rounding/headroom. Actual current stored logs only ~80KB. Not a measured invoice.
planning_basis.ecr: Two current images total 932082994 bytes before shared-layer deduplication; reserve 1GB at $0.10/GB-month.
planning_basis.sqs: 5 long-pollers at 20 seconds over 730h, plus 3 operations/job; no account free tier deduction. Max concurrency configured, so do not assume 2-poller idle optimization.
planning_basis.domain_and_misc: 300 JPY/month service-wide provisional allowance; no registrar invoice supplied. Human labor explicitly zero, not claimed to be covered.
planning_basis.free_accounts: 13 current plan-managed Free accounts, all charged at full 45min/1GiB/30-answer quota. Approx 60 JPY each reserved, rather than estimating growth from the present low utilization. 50/100 free-account sensitivities included.
planning_basis.r2: Full storage quotas interpreted as GiB, converted to decimal billing GB. No storage free-tier credit assumed; add one shared GB rounding reserve. Operation cost zero only while the whole account stays below 1M Class A / 10M Class B per month. No video egress charge.
planning_basis.ai: Planning 8000 total input and 600 total output tokens per answer + query embeddings + 15% failed-attempt allowance rounded to 0.30 JPY. This remains unmeasured; retirement of RAGAS does not change generation quality or impose a token cap.
planning_basis.tax_fx: 10% consumption-tax-equivalent revenue reserve and 4.3% Stripe fees on gross receipts; not a tax return calculation. FX160 planning rate, not spot. Refunds and chargebacks excluded.
planning_basis.aws_transfer: 64kbps audio = 480000 bytes/video-minute, plus 65536 bytes/video-minute reserved for DB/index/API outbound data. Tokyo public Internet egress $0.114/GB, verified AWSDataTransfer offer publication 2026-09-16. Shared AWS 100GB free allowance not deducted. R2 download ingress to Lambda is free; Lambda outbound traffic is separate.

september_aws_invoice_note: Account-level Cost Explorer totals were inspected but not used as recurring VideoQ overhead: shared services, free tiers and legacy evaluation jobs make them unsuitable for 50-contract forecasting.
